indirect_reasons: Her two worst lanes both moved against her: Warden got flask travel speed, -30% weapon-damage reduction and Willpower +20%, and Billy got Rising Ram T3 +15%/20s and Blasted 27s->25s.
Two other counters softened: Mo & Krill's spirit damage on all abilities -10% blunts the Combo that lifts her, and Wraith lost Card Trick heal 60->45 and Project Mind cooldown 46s->50s.
Bullet Resilience 30%->35% bullet resist is a small tax on a pure-gun kit, partly offset by Glass Cannon 80%->85%.
heroes.one_liner: No direct change; Warden and Billy got stronger, M&K and Wraith weaker - roughly flat.

indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60%->45% hits the ~79% HVR/Opening Rounds lane opener that is his only real lane pressure.
His dive counters got direct buffs: Drifter base gun damage +3% and Eternal Night T3 +2.75s, Calico Leaping Slash T3 +90 and Ava T3 8s.
Lightning Scroll now scales 0.35 off spirit power, giving his duration/cooldown spirit shell a poke option it did not have.
build_changes: Delay the HVR lane opener or accept weaker max-range poke; consider Lightning Scroll as a spirit-scaling poke slot in the duration build.
heroes.one_liner: HVR lane package nerfed and his dive counters buffed; still a coin-flip C.

indirect_reasons: Haunt bounty +10% rewards her grouped-camp AoE clear, and the comeback package (gold cap 26%->30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind) helps a 44.8% WR hero.
Steam Vents losing invisibility removes the free dive approach the KB credited her, and tunnels +70%->+50% slows her roam.
Her worst lane Ivy lost Healing Booster's Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen, but Victor gained Spirit Lifesteal, Infuser and Torment Pulse buffs and Billy got Rising Ram T3 +15%/20s.
heroes.one_liner: AoE camp clear pays more, but vents lost invis and her tank counters got tankier.

direct_reasons: Base gun damage +3% and Bloodscent T3 +11%->+12% amplified damage sharpen the melee-proc trade he already wins early.
Eternal Night T3 +2.5s->+2.75s extends his ult window slightly.
indirect_reasons: Decay heal cut -50%->-55% strengthens his anti-heal bruiser variant, and Healbane now stacking makes team anti-heal a real lever.
Healing Snacks 10%->14% max HP and the new Heavy-Melee Cauldrons reward his melee core and camp-chip sustain.
Mo & Krill's spirit damage -10% softens one of his listed counters; Apollo's Riposte is now an immobilize rather than a stun, so it no longer fully locks his dive.
build_changes: Anti-heal bruiser variant gains: Decay is now a stronger slot into sustain comps.
heroes.one_liner: Small gun/T3 buffs plus Decay and anti-heal stacking - still a blind-pick bruiser.

direct_reasons: Ira Domini blessed stake damage 115->95 but boon scaling 3->3.6: a weaker early stake that overtakes the old value later, so his lane poke is trimmed and his mid-game is not.
Battle Vest weapon damage 18%->22% and Bullet Lifesteal 6%->10% weapon damage / 13%->15% lifesteal both buff his gun-bruiser primary shell.
indirect_reasons: Graves - his hard counter whose gun deletes his traps - took move speed 7->6.7, bullet damage per boon -4% and a slower Grasping Hands deploy.
High-Velocity Rounds 60%->45% does not touch him (he opens Restorative Shot/Close Quarters/Monster Rounds), while it does hit Vindicta, another listed counter.
Warden (flask, Willpower, Last Stand T2) and Abrams (base gun damage +5%, Siphon T3 +22) both got stronger, and both are losing lanes for him.
build_changes: Lean harder into Battle Vest + Bullet Lifesteal as the lane-sustain spine; treat Ira Domini as a mid-game spike rather than an early bully tool.
heroes.one_liner: Battle Vest and Bullet Lifesteal buffs offset a weaker early stake; Graves nerf helps.

direct_reasons: Aura of Suffering T3 +15%->+16% damage is a token bump on his grind-down frontline.
indirect_reasons: Three of his core sustain items were buffed: Spirit Lifesteal 6->8 spirit / 13%->15%, Infuser 70%->75% active lifesteal and 6->8 spirit, Torment Pulse 18%->22% melee resist.
Healing Booster lost its Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen, which is a real hit to his sustain stack - the buffs above roughly cancel it.
Harder Haunt camps (bounty and HP both +10%) and Healing Snacks 10%->14% both reward his camp-grinding sustain line; Ivy, his worst lane, lost the same healing items.
build_changes: Shift sustain weight from Healing Booster to Spirit Lifesteal/Infuser; keep Torment Pulse as the frontline layer.
heroes.one_liner: Spirit Lifesteal/Infuser/Torment Pulse buffs beat the Healing Booster trim - still A.

direct_reasons: Base bullet damage 35->32 is a ~9% cut to the level-1 lane pressure that is her entire identity; the growth buff 0.52->0.61 only breaks even around boon 33, so she is weaker at every realistic point.
Bookwyrm T2 trail duration +2s->+1s trims her zone control.
indirect_reasons: High-Velocity Rounds bullet velocity 60%->45% hits her 1.2-minute lane opener directly.
The comeback package (non-hero gold cap 26%->30%, Haunted Souls up to 50% faster when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) directly attacks the lane-win-then-snowball conversion that made her S.
Breakables growth -10% trims the lane-adjacent crate routes she converts lane pressure into; Healing Snacks 10%->14% partly offsets by letting her lane pressure stick.
build_changes: Do not sit on base HVR for max-range poke; upgrade it faster or open Opening Rounds first. Expect to win lane by less and convert through crate routes rather than a kill snowball.
heroes.one_liner: Lane damage cut and comeback souls restored - her snowball converts less.

direct_reasons: Luggage Cart T2 wall-impact damage +75->+90 and T3 cooldown -15s->-18s are both straight buffs to his setup tool.
indirect_reasons: The comeback package helps a 45.4% WR hero that loses to tempo rather than to numbers.
His listed counters Yamato (Power Slash spirit scaling +6%) and Lash (Grapple T3 +4m jump velocity) both got small buffs, so the dive that beats his setup did not get slower.
heroes.one_liner: Luggage Cart buffs are real but small; still a setup initiator in a tempo meta.

direct_reasons: Rising Ram T3 +10% max health for 16s -> +15% for 20s is a real frontline durability buff on his engage.
Blasted cooldown 27s->25s gives slightly more uptime on his all-in.
indirect_reasons: Spirit Shielding 18%->15% spirit resist trims his spirit shred/slow variant's defensive layer.
Decay -50%->-55% heal cut strengthens his anti-heal frontline role in a patch that pushes anti-heal hard.

His worst lane Shiv is roughly flat (Serrated Knives rage 3.5%->4% current HP up, alt-fire per boon -5% and Killing Blow recast 16s->12s down), while Warden and Seven both got small buffs against him.
heroes.one_liner: Rising Ram T3 and Blasted buffs, but Warden and Shiv still out-sustain him.

direct_reasons: Move speed 7->6.7 and bullet damage per boon -4% cut both her kiting and her damage on a hero with the worst early game of any carry.
Grasping Hands deploy 0.6s->0.8s and now more easily double-jumped over removes a chunk of the zoning that keeps divers off her.
Borrowed Decree T2 loses -0.3s spawn time and T3 gains it - a straight delay to her summon tempo.
indirect_reasons: Echo Shard post-cast 0.5s->0.2s buffs her summoner/cooldown primary build's double-cast execution.
The comeback package (gold cap 26%->30%, faster Haunted Souls when behind, tick souls to the two poorest) is the bail-out her ~25-minute window never had.
Her counters split: Warden buffed (flask, Willpower, Last Stand T2) and Calico buffed (Leaping Slash T3 +90, Ava T3 8s), but Wraith nerfed (Card Trick heal 60->45, Project Mind 46s->50s).
build_changes: Echo Shard is now a faster, more reliable core in the summoner build; lean on it rather than on Grasping Hands zoning for safety.
heroes.one_liner: Top win rate ate a broad nerf; Echo Shard buff and comeback souls soften it.

direct_reasons: Riposte Pommel Hit disable 0.8s->1.5s (T2 +0.4s->+0.6s) nearly doubles his lockdown window, even though it is now an immobilize plus parry disable rather than a stun.
Riposte dash fixes stop the counterattack whiffing on moving, cornered or displaced targets - reliability he did not have.
Flawless Advance now refunds the stab and keeps remaining recasts when stunned or slept, and Itani Lo Sahn is no longer interrupted by Sleep - two hard removals of his worst punish windows.
indirect_reasons: Healing Booster losing its Extra Regen component and flat +3 regen thins the sustain shell his spirit bruiser build leans on.
Healbane now stacking is a team anti-heal gain but its heal-on-kill 275->170+3/boon is a personal sustain loss - roughly neutral for him.
His losing lanes split: Warden and Abrams both buffed, but Wraith (Card Trick heal, Project Mind cooldown) and Mo & Krill (spirit damage -10%) both nerfed.
build_changes: Re-weight sustain toward Restorative Locket/Dispel Magic rather than Healing Booster; the longer Riposte disable makes pick-oriented spirit burst better than the old tank-and-outlast line.
heroes.one_liner: Riposte is now a 1.5s immobilize and Flawless Advance refunds on CC - big pick buff.

indirect_reasons: Healing Booster no longer builds from Extra Regen and loses its flat +3 regen - the backbone of his sustain layer is gone.
Divine Barrier cooldown 45s->55s cuts a cast window per fight off his best-WR late item.
Decay -50%->-55% heal cut is a small gain on his anti-heal slot, and the comeback package helps a 45.1% WR hero; his worst lane Ivy lost the same healing items.
build_changes: Stop treating Healing Booster as a cheap Extra Regen upgrade; buy it standalone or route the slot into Spirit Lifesteal, which was buffed.
heroes.one_liner: Healing Booster and Divine Barrier both trimmed; his sustain shell is thinner.
